faq1_q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq1_a: Check-in is from 3:00 pm to 10:00 pm (if you arrive after 10:00 pm, let us know). Check-out is from 7:30 am to 10:30 am; late check-out after 12:00 noon is available on request, for a fee.
faq2_q: Is the hotel really adults only?
faq2_a: Yes. Nivis is reserved for an adult clientele and is the only Adults Only hotel in Folgarida. We welcome guests from 13-14 years of age: for special cases, write to us.
faq3_a: Yes, Nivis is pet friendly: we have rooms where small and medium-sized animals are welcome, on request, with a dedicated welcome kit.
faq4_q: How do I get to the ski slopes?
faq4_a: The slopes are 5 minutes away. The hotel offers a free shuttle to and from the ski lifts; Madonna di Campiglio is 10 km away.
faq5_q: What are the spa and pool opening hours?
faq5_a: The spa is open every day from 2:30 pm to 7:30 pm, the heated indoor pool at 32°C from 10:00 am to 7:30 pm. Massages are booked in advance and can be cancelled up to 24 hours before.
faq6_q: Is breakfast included? Can I have dinner at the hotel?
faq6_a: Buffet breakfast is included (7:30–10:30). The restaurant also serves brunch and dinners with dedicated menus, with ethical cuisine and local produce, in the dining room, the private veranda or the romantic room.
faq7_q: Where can I park and store my equipment?
faq7_a: The covered garage costs 10 euros per night, by reservation. A ski room and bike storage are available; you can rent skis, snowshoes and e-bikes.
faq8_a: Directly online on the hotel's official engine, by phone on +39 0463 986234 or by email at info@nivishotel.it. For a tailor-made proposal, use the request form.
